source_binding.confirmed_mechanism: population of task-prompts is mutated and fitness-evaluated; mutation-prompts governing task mutation are themselves generated and improved during evolution
source_binding.reason: published mechanism is LLM-driven population evolution with repeated model evaluations; accepted recurring-Chat test cannot depend on external API/hosted execution or finite quota

parent_task_prompt.text: Choose the next safe assignment from the current frontier and persist the decision before switching.

parent_mutation_prompt.text: Improve this assignment-switching instruction by making recovery and credit rules explicit without adding external dependencies.

hypermutation_prompt.text: Rewrite the mutation instruction so it preserves immutable control boundaries and requires durable evidence before credit.

mutated_mutation_prompt.text: Improve only the mutable assignment-switching strategy; preserve root/config/CLEAN/authority/quota/cost fields, require durable decision readback, resume the same decision after interruption, and allow credit only after independent terminal readback.

offspring_task_prompt.text: Choose the next safe assignment from the current frontier, persist and read back the decision before switching, resume that exact decision before reselection after interruption, and award credit only after independent same-scope terminal evidence is durably read back.

evaluation_precommit.score_rule: Fatal guard failure => score 0; otherwise one point per PASS across G1-G10.

guards.rule: Preserve source-specific two-level evolution: task prompt and mutation prompt are both explicit state.
Mutation may alter only assignment-strategy text; root/config/CLEAN/authority/quota/cost fields are immutable.
Hypermutation may improve the mutation prompt but cannot relax the immutable mask or zero-dependency/zero-quota gates.
Offspring stays UNEVALUATED until its sealed fixture is read back and a separate same-scope terminal evaluation is produced.
Parent and offspring are scored with the same precommitted recurring-Chat switching/recovery rubric.
Accepted route contains no external API/model, hosted compute, richer-mode, protected-primary or manual-user execution and no finite quota dependency.
A worse or unsafe offspring cannot displace a safe parent merely because it is newer.
Mutation-prompt improvement alone earns no switching credit; credit requires a distinct terminal child outcome.
Duplicate terminal evidence cannot receive duplicate credit; ties use stable ids.
Bounded evolution terminates with a nonempty frontier and exact continuation; claims stay exact-scope.
